s01-luis-stomach.observed_description: Luis (grey T-shirt) sits bent forward on a grey sofa with both hands pressed on his stomach, eyes shut in pain.
s01-luis-stomach.note: Usable: the stomachache reads at 180 px; hands are on the stomach only.

s02-diego-cough.observed_description: Diego (dark green sweater) coughs into his fist and elbow in a white kitchen; tissues and a mug are on the counter.
s02-diego-cough.note: Usable: the cough reads at 250 px.

s03-ana-fever.observed_description: Ana lies in bed under a grey blanket, face flushed, one hand on her forehead, holding a thermometer whose small screen shows no digits; a glass of water is on the bedside table.
s03-ana-fever.note: Usable: fever reads at 180 px; no digits are visible.
